Sales Representative (Industrial Products) (Full-Time) – Ausgreen Solar Solutions, NSW & ACT

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
11 Recruitment is assisting Ausgreen Solar Solutions with the recruitment process. If you are a dedicated sales professional with experience in industrial products and a passion for renewable energy solutions, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your sales career.

Job description

Australia Network Services Pty Ltd (ANS) is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Software Engineer for our client operating in the software development, IT services, and digital solutions industry in Sydney, Australia.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for surface preparation, installing and finishing plasterboard, applying plaster and render, and ensuring all wall and ceiling surfaces are smooth, durable, and finished to our exacting standards—on time and to specification. We value hands-on experience in a fast-paced construction or maintenance environment, particularly where versatility and reliability are key. 4. Installing corner beads, trims, and decorative features such as cornices, mouldings, and architectural plaster details.
5. Taping and wet-sanding joints and fastener points, then sanding finished areas to a high standard before handover.
6. Inspecting completed work for quality and compliance, while maintaining a clean, safe worksite and following all health and safety procedures.

1. AQF IV plus 1 year relevant full-time experience or 3 years relevant full-time experience.

3. Capable of working independently, managing tasks effectively, and meeting project deadlines.

Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

Position Overview
We are looking for a results-driven ICT Sales Representative to identify, develop and convert sales opportunities across a range of technology products and services. This role focuses on building strong client relationships, understanding business needs, and delivering tailored ICT solutions. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, technically aware, and confident in managing the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through to post-sale support.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new business opportunities for ICT products, services and solutions
Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients to understand their technology requirements
Present and demonstrate ICT solutions, including hardware, software and managed services
Prepare and negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contractual agreements with clients
Manage the end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation through to closing deals and order processing
Coordinate delivery, installation and implementation of ICT solutions with internal and external stakeholders
Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities
Maintain accurate records of sales activities, pipeline status and client interactions within CRM systems
Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts and expense records to management
Follow up with clients post-sale to ensure satisfaction, resolve issues and identify upsell opportunities
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions meet client expectations and technical requirements
Ensure compliance with organisational policies, sales procedures and quality standards
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Marketing or a related field
Proven experience in ICT sales, account management or business development
Strong understanding of ICT products and services, including hardware, software and cloud solutions
Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs
Excellent negotiation, communication and presentation skills
Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value for clients
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts
Experience using CRM systems and sales reporting tools
Commercial awareness and customer-focused mindset
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in B2B technology sales within the Australian market
Familiarity with cloud platforms, cybersecurity solutions or enterprise systems
Certifications in sales methodologies or vendor technologies (e.g. Microsoft, Cisco)
Established network of industry contacts or client relationships
Experience working with cross-functional technical and delivery teams
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work with innovative ICT solutions and a diverse client base
Supportive and high-performance sales environment
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
Clear career progression pathways within a growing organisation
Competitive remuneration with performance-based incentives
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Butcher – Halal Meat Shop – Clayton VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working to assist a well-established and reputable provider of high-quality halal meat products serving the local Clayton community with a strong commitment to freshness, hygiene, and authenticity. We are seeking a skilled and qualified Halal Butcher to join their team on a full-time basis.

•	Salary: Negotiable in the range of $75k to $85k plus superannuation per annum.

•	Tenure: Full time and ongoing.

•	Location: Clayton VIC

Key Responsibilities include: 

•	Prepare, cut, trim, and portion meat in accordance with halal standards.

•	Handling and processing meat using knives, cleavers, saws, sausage filling machines, smoking chambers, and other equipment.

•	Seasoning, marinating, curing, and coating meat products.

•	Ensure all processing complies with Islamic dietary requirements and hygiene regulations.

•	Maintain product quality, freshness, and presentation standards.

•	Assist with stock handling, storage, and rotation.

•	Provide courteous service and basic product guidance to customers.

•	Always uphold workplace cleanliness, food safety logs, food safety practices (HACCP Principles), and halal certification requirements.

To be successfully considered for the role you:

•	Applicant will ideally hold relevant vocational qualifications (Certificate IV or agreed equivalent) in a relevant field.

•	At least 1 year of relevant employment proven experience in meat preparation or butchery.

•	Are available across the retail working week.

•	Sound understanding of halal practices and compliance requirements or a willingness to learn

•	Ability to safely operate butchery tools and equipment.

•	Strong attention to detail and consistency in workmanship.

•	Reliable, punctual, and able to work in a team environment.

•	Possess a thorough understanding of food safety and HACCP.

•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

•	Strong communication and customer service skills.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.
